How it works

Working Principle of 4 Side Seal Packing Machine

Film Roll Feeding

Laminated packaging film roll is mounted onto film unwinding section

Pouch Forming Process

Film is shaped and prepared into sachet structure automatically

➜ Machine forms premium sachet suitable for four-side sealing operation.

Product Filling Operation

Machine handles: ✔ Powders ✔ Granules ✔ Liquids ✔ Paste products ✔ Spices ✔ Pharma products ✔ Cosmetic products accurately and continuously.

Four Side Sealing Process

Machine seals sachet from: Left side Right side Top side Bottom side creating a strong, leak-proof, and attractive premium package.

Cutting & Coding Integration

Automatic cutting system separates finished sachets Optional systems include: Batch coding Date printing QR code printing Barcode printing

Finished Sachet Discharge

Finished pouches discharged automatically for: Collection Cartoning Secondary packaging Dispatch operations
